description: Defines the egl::Stream class, representing a streaming object for frames, including consumer and producer configurations, attributes, and related methods.

classes.name: egl::Stream
classes.description: Represents a stream object for frame streaming, with methods for configuration, consumer/producer management, and texture handling.

methods.name: Stream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream with display and attributes.

methods.name: ~Stream
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the stream.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label of the stream.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the stream.

methods.name: setConsumerLatency
methods.description: Sets the latency for the consumer.

methods.name: getConsumerLatency
methods.description: Gets the current consumer latency.

methods.name: getProducerFrame
methods.description: Returns the current producer frame timestamp.

methods.name: getConsumerFrame
methods.description: Returns the current consumer frame timestamp.

methods.name: setConsumerAcquireTimeout
methods.description: Sets the acquire timeout for the consumer.

methods.name: getConsumerAcquireTimeout
methods.description: Gets the consumer acquire timeout.

methods.name: getConsumerType
methods.description: Returns the consumer type.

methods.name: getProducerType
methods.description: Returns the producer type.

methods.name: getPlaneCount
methods.description: Returns the number of planes (for YUV textures).

methods.name: getImplementation
methods.description: Returns the producer implementation object.

methods.name: createConsumerGLTextureExternal
methods.description: Creates a GL texture external consumer.

methods.name: createProducerD3D11Texture
methods.description: Creates a D3D11 texture producer.

methods.name: consumerAcquire
methods.description: Acquires the consumer for frame processing.

methods.name: consumerRelease
methods.description: Releases the consumer after processing.

methods.name: isConsumerBoundToContext
methods.description: Checks if the consumer is bound to a specific GL context.

methods.name: validateD3D11Texture
methods.description: Validates a D3D11 texture.

methods.name: postD3D11Texture
methods.description: Posts a D3D11 texture to the stream.

methods.name: releaseTextures
methods.description: Releases associated textures (internal use).
